title: The Part Sale table shows Priced By after Sell Price
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit' and 'Part Sales — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is % Off 10.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for Part Sales in Edit Customer.
  • Have a new Part Sale for this test, Part Sale 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tiers were set, with one part in category A priced by tier A and one part with a typed price.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Open Part Sale 1.
  2. Point at the tier-priced part's Priced By value.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The parts table's columns read Description, Part Number, Quantity, Cost, Core, Sell Price, Priced By, Margin, Category, Vendor and Requested At, as in picture 13.3.
  • The tier-priced part reads tier A's name.
  • The typed part reads Manual with the gray Manual icon.

Step 2:

  • The price details open beside the value, titled "Why this price".
  • Their rows read Priced by, Matrix, Cost Range, Rule, Cost, Sell price, Priced on and From, as in picture 13.4.
